capabilities.title: Metrology & Inspection
capabilities.summary: High-precision measurement, non-contact optical analysis, and inspection tools to rapidly evaluate physical prototypes.
capabilities.body:
# Metrology & Inspection

The Metrology & Inspection capability provides users with precise optical and digital measurement equipment to rapidly inspect fabricated parts, verify physical dimensions, and track surface deformation against CAD and simulation models.

## Focus Areas

- Non-contact 3D surface deformation and optical strain tracking (DIC).
- Precision dimensional measurement and quality inspection of fabricated parts.
- Physical validation of computational simulation models (FEA/CFD).

## Related Items

### :material-wrench: Associated Tools & Equipment
- **[Digital Image Correlation (DIC) Optical System](../tools/dic-camera-system.md)**: High-speed stereoscopic camera system for real-time 3D optical surface deformation and strain tracking.
- **[Digital Inspection Microscope](../tools/digital-microscope.md)**: High-magnification digital stereo microscope with integrated HD camera for optical surface inspection, solder joint validation, and micro-defect analysis.
- **[Metrology-Grade Structured Light 3D Scanner](../tools/structured-light-scanner.md)**: High-precision structured light 3D scanner for detailed surface measurement and inspection applications.
- **[High-Resolution Thermal Imaging Camera](../tools/thermal-camera.md)**: Non-contact infrared thermal camera for full-field heat mapping, thermal throttling analysis, and PCB hot-spot inspection.

# Robotics & Automation

The Robotics & Automation capability provides users with compact collaborative robots, motion controllers, and vision guidance sensors to rapidly prototype automated manipulation, assembly, inspection, and maintenance sequences.

## Focus Areas

- Collaborative robot (cobot) programming and end-effector integration.
- Vision-guided positioning and target tracking for automated inspection and maintenance.
- Quick-change tool interfaces (magnetic, pneumatic, mechanical) for multi-purpose robotic tasks.

## Related Items

# Benchtop Collaborative Robot Arm

Compact 6-axis collaborative robot arm used in the DTC Model Shop for prototyping automated pick-and-place routines, testing custom 3D-printed end-effectors, and developing automated maintenance workflows.

## Features
- 6-degree-of-freedom articulated arm with torque feedback safety sensors for cage-free operation.
- Standardized tool flange interface supporting quick-change magnetic and pneumatic tool changers.
- Programmable digital/analog I/O and Ethernet interface for integrating grippers and sensors.
- Teach pendant and Python/ROS API support for rapid trajectory and motion sequence development.

## Related Items

Benchtop multi-channel programmable DC power supply used in the DTC Model Shop to deliver regulated voltage rails and measure dynamic power consumption across electronic prototypes and edge compute hardware.

## Features
- Multi-channel isolated DC outputs with precise voltage and current limit regulation.
- High-resolution real-time voltage, current, and wattage monitoring.
- Dynamic data logging for profiling power spikes, idle power, and watt-per-inference metrics.

# Digital Image Correlation (DIC) Optical System

Stereoscopic optical metrology tool used in the DTC Model Shop to capture high-speed 3D surface deformation, strain distribution, and displacement fields without physical contact.

## Features
- High-resolution dual stereo camera setup with synchronized high-speed capture.
- Real-time full-field 3D strain mapping and displacement tracking under load.
- Direct export of optical deformation mesh data for comparison against FEA simulation models.
- Non-contact measurement ideal for lightweight composite, carbon fiber, and 3D-printed components.

tools.body:
# PCB CNC Milling & Prototyping Station

High-precision desktop CNC milling machine used in the DTC Model Shop for rapid in-house prototyping of single- and double-sided printed circuit boards (PCBs), trace isolation milling, and hole drilling.

## Features
- Rapid isolation milling and contour routing for copper-clad laminates (FR-4, Rogers).
- Automatic tool change and high-speed spindle for micro-drilling through-holes and vias.
- Integrated height sensing for precise copper isolation depth without chemical etching.
- Supports Gerber and Excellon drill files generated by standard EDA packages (Altium, KiCad, Eagle).

tools.body:
# Soldering & Rework Station

Precision electronic assembly and rework station used in the DTC Model Shop for wire harness fabrication, through-hole PCB assembly, surface-mount (SMD) soldering, and circuit component desoldering/repair.

## Features
- Dual-function temperature-controlled soldering iron and hot air rework tool.
- Precision tips for fine-pitch surface-mount (SMD) components and dense PCB assemblies.
- High-capacity iron for heavy gauge wiring and wire harness soldering.
- Integrated vacuum desoldering pump and wick for rapid component removal and board repair.
- Variable temperature and airflow controls suitable for leaded and lead-free alloys.
- ESD-safe design to protect sensitive microelectronics and ICs during assembly.

projects.title: Airframe Arm Deflection & Strain Test Bench
projects.summary: A custom structural test fixture constructed using DTC Model Shop rapid prototyping, framing, and electronic tools to validate UAV airframe arm deflection against FEA predictions via DIC optical metrology.
projects.body:
# Airframe Arm Deflection & Strain Test Bench

- **Physical:** A custom mechanical test jig constructed using aluminum T-slot framing and 3D-printed mounts, holding a 3D-printed or carbon fiber UAV arm under static and dynamic motor thrust loads.
        
- **Digital/Metrology:** Utilizes high-resolution stereoscopic cameras (DIC) to track optical surface deformation in real-time, comparing empirical deflection data against Ansys FEA predictions.
    
- **Member Interest:** Optical metrology (Trilion), simulation validation (Ansys), structural materials testing (UDRI).

projects.title: Closed-Loop Additive Manufacturing In-Situ Metrology Rig
projects.summary: An FDM 3D printer instrumented with a thermal imaging camera and optical inspection optics for in-situ monitoring of layer deposition, thermal void formation, and defect detection.
projects.body:
# Closed-Loop Additive Manufacturing In-Situ Metrology Rig

- **Physical:** A desktop 3D printer instrumented with a thermal camera and optical microscope aimed at the print nozzle.
    
- **Digital/AI:** Detects layer misalignments or thermal void formations during the build and feeds layer-by-layer defect maps back into CAD/FEA software to predict part strength loss before completion.
    
- **Member Interest:** Smart manufacturing (ARCTOS, Sinclair), digital thread integration (AFMC DTO, UDRI), physics simulation (Ansys).
